SELECT b.b_idx AS brnIdx, b.b_name AS brnName, b.b_address AS brnAddress, b.b_description AS brnDescription, b.b_latitude AS brnLatitude, b.b_altitude AS brnLongitude, b.b_phone AS brnPhone, b.b_file AS brnFile, b.b_active AS brnActive
, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(b.b_latitude)) * cos(radians(b.b_altitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(b.b_latitude)))) AS distance
FROM branch b
b.b_active = 1
AND ( b.b_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.b_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.b_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND s.s_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
AND b.b_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND s.s_max_capacity >= #{capacity})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_parking = 1)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_24hours = 1)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_pet = 1)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_wifi = 1)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_coffee = 1)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_printer = 1)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_locker = 1)
AND (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(b.b_latitude)) * cos(radians(b.b_altitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(b.b_latitude)))) < 5
ORDER BY distance ASC

SELECT b_idx AS brnIdx, b_name AS brnName, b_address AS brnAddress, b_description AS brnDescription, b_latitude AS brnLatitude, b_altitude AS brnLongitude, b_phone AS brnPhone, b_file AS brnFile, b_active AS brnActive FROM branch WHERE b_active = 1
